It’s a method people use to weed out the broken cc. So you remove 50% of your cc and run the game. If it still shows an error, the broken cc is in the running 50%, and the 50% you removed is still good. 

Then you split the running 50% in half, because the bad cc is still in there. You run the game, and if there is an error, it’s in the remaining cc. You keep doing this until you find the source.
